mapper.insert: INSERT INTO clubJoin( clubJoin_num, memberIdx, clubOwner_key, clubJoin_content, clubJoin_date, clubJoin_result, clubJoin_intro, clubJoin_position, clubJoin_reason ) VALUES( clubJoin_seq.NEXTVAL, #{memberIdx}, #{clubOwner_key}, #{clubJoin_content}, TO_DATE(#{clubJoin_date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{clubJoin_result}, #{clubJoin_intro}, #{clubJoin_position}, #{clubJoin_reason})
